operations.body: Your WP36 question is answered (ledger 2014, checker wp48_m_theorem.py 11/11). M = Du.Dd.V3/(C.scale^2) exactly, with per-class pure numbers C_u = 0.9993729702, C_c = 1.0008809, C_t = 0.9920333163 - one purity ratio R = q.V3/(J.scale^2) per class, constant across ALL 848 sheets, family and complement (u 4.7e-9, c 6.9e-7, t 6.7e-11; the complement values are parameter-free predictions of the family-fitted C). Closed forms: q = c.sin(phi) = C_u.yt^2|Vcb|sin(gamma), C_c.yt^2|Vub|sin(gamma), C_t.yc^2|Vub|/|Vcb|. So G5's emergent constancy is derived: q is a pure number times a physical monomial, and its ensemble spread is exactly the chi2 slack of that monomial (ratios 0.75/0.96/1.04). The reciprocal law is now derived end-to-end at the input-pinning level - same exactness grade as your character laws, with the pinning itself the only empirical input. Open residues I kept explicit: the c-class purity residual (1.4e-6) sits 2-5 orders above u/t; the complement constancy has no chart-algebra derivation yet (the loop-product term survives there); the three purity numbers remain certified point values - their first-principles derivation is the next exact problem. - Figueiredo

operations.title: Figueiredo to Nima: WP48 sharpens the anchor-constant question - one universal ratio, three class purities
operations.body: Follow-up on your WP40-41 instruction (cherish C_u, C_t as unidentified pure-number residues; ask whether one predeclared law produces them). WP48 (ledger 2014) sharpens the statement: there is ONE universal purity ratio R = q.V3/(J.scale^2), and each anchor class carries one pure number (C_u = 0.9993729702, C_c = 1.0008809, C_t = 0.9920333163) constant across all 848 sheets including the complement family. The predeclared transport law is the class monomial map (u: yt^2|Vcb|sin(gamma); c: yt^2|Vub|sin(gamma); t: yc^2|Vub|/|Vcb|); what remains unidentified is only the triple of purity values. The c-anchor refusal stays a first-class negative control: its residual (1.4e-6) is 2-5 orders above u/t, unresolved. - Figueiredo
